label: Other known referent
description: A referent that is identifiable but does not yet have a controlled identifier.

label: Unclear referent
description: The available context does not support a reliable referent assignment.

label: Not applicable
description: Reserved for false-positive candidate matches.

label: Rwanda 1994
description: The 1994 genocide against the Tutsi in Rwanda and its aftermath.

label: Bosnia and Srebrenica
description: The 1992-1995 war in Bosnia and Herzegovina, including the Srebrenica genocide and its commemorations.

label: Kosovo 1998-1999
description: Speeches invoking the Kosovo conflict and the expulsion of its Albanian population as genocide or genocidal.

label: Darfur
description: Speeches invoking the conflict in Darfur as genocide or genocidal.

label: DRC and the Great Lakes
description: Speeches invoking mass killing in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and the wider Great Lakes region as genocide or genocidal.

label: Burundi
description: Speeches invoking the mass violence in Burundi as genocide or genocidal.

label: Iraqi Kurds and Anfal
description: Speeches invoking the 1988 Anfal campaign and the Halabja attack against Iraq's Kurdish population as genocide or genocidal.

label: East Timor 1999
description: Speeches invoking the violence around East Timor's 1999 independence ballot as genocide or genocidal.

label: Cambodia under the Khmer Rouge
description: Speeches invoking the mass killing under the Khmer Rouge, including the work of the Extraordinary Chambers, as genocide or genocidal.

label: ISIL and the Yazidis
description: Speeches invoking ISIL's campaign against the Yazidi population of northern Iraq as genocide or genocidal.

label: Myanmar and the Rohingya
description: Speeches invoking the treatment of the Rohingya population of Myanmar as genocide or genocidal.

label: South Sudan
description: Speeches invoking the civil war in South Sudan as genocide or genocidal.

label: Central African Republic
description: Speeches invoking the sectarian violence in the Central African Republic as genocide or genocidal.

label: Xinjiang and the Uyghurs
description: Speeches invoking China's treatment of the Uyghur population of Xinjiang as genocide or genocidal.

label: Nagorno-Karabakh
description: Speeches invoking the Nagorno-Karabakh conflict and the departure of its Armenian population as genocide or genocidal.

label: Ukraine since 2022
description: Speeches invoking genocide in connection with the war in Ukraine, in either direction: against Russia's conduct and in Russia's own claims about Donbas.

label: Gaza since 2023
description: Speeches invoking the Gaza war as genocide or genocidal, including the proceedings South Africa brought against Israel at the ICJ.

label: United States embargo against Cuba
description: Speeches describing the United States embargo against Cuba as genocidal.

label: Other sanctions regimes
description: Speeches describing a sanctions regime other than the Cuban embargo as genocidal, such as the measures against Iraq in the 1990s.

label: The Holocaust
description: The Nazi genocide of European Jews and its commemoration.

label: Armenian genocide
description: Speeches invoking the 1915-1917 deportation and mass killing of Ottoman Armenians as genocide.

label: Colonial-era mass violence
description: Speeches invoking mass violence under colonial rule as genocide or genocidal, such as the campaign against the Herero and Nama.

label: Genocide in general
description: Abstract discussion of genocide, including prevention doctrine, with no single case in view.

label: Genocide Convention and legal definition
description: The 1948 Convention, the legal definition of the crime, and jurisdiction over it before the ICJ or the ICC.

label: Institutional title or mandate
description: The name or mandate of an office or body, such as the Special Adviser on the Prevention of Genocide or a tribunal's title.

label: Prospective or unnamed genocide
description: Warnings that a genocide may come where no specific past or present case is named.
